channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Four Potential Eastern Landing Spots For Rangers' Vincent Trocheck
item.description: New York Rangers center Vincent Trocheck said if he were to be moved by Friday's NHL trade deadline, he would want to go to a contender in the Eastern Conference.

item.title: Dallas Stars Bringing In D-Man Tyler Myers From Vancouver Canucks
item.description: The red-hot Dallas Stars are adding a big defenseman, Tyler Myers, in a trade with the Vancouver Canucks.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Is There A GM Under More Pressure Than Oilers' Stan Bowman?
item.description: Drew Shore, Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos discuss the Connor Murphy and Tyler Myers trades, Robert Thomas trade rumors, the Oilers and more.

item.title: NHL Power Rankings: Step Aside, Colorado – There's A New No. 1
item.description: Lost amid the trade deadline buzz are the Colorado Avalanche not looking as dominant lately and the Dallas Stars taking over the top spot in the NHL power rankings.

item.title: Kiefer Sherwood Is Going Nowhere: Hitting Machine Brings Key Ingredients To Sharks
item.description: Kiefer Sherwood was already moved once this season, and he had surfaced again in trade speculation before Friday's deadline. The Sharks made it clear as they put the finishing touches on their rebuild: he's going nowhere.

item.title: Maple Leafs Scratch McMann, Laughton And Ekman-Larsson Ahead Of NHL Trade Deadline
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs veterans Bobby McMann, Scott Laughton and Oliver Ekman-Larsson have surfaced in trade rumors and speculation ahead of Friday's deadline.

item.title: Is The Canucks' Rebuild About To Reach Full Force?
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks traded Tyler Myers, and based on quotes and rumors this week, they have more moves in store to really get the rebuild going.

item.title: Utah Mammoth Upgrade Their Defense Yet Again By Acquiring MacKenzie Weegar From Flames
item.description: The Utah Mammoth have now added MacKenzie Weegar, Mikhail Sergachev and John Marino since the summer of 2024.

item.title: Social Media Reacts To Flames Trading MacKenzie Weegar: 'I'll Take The Pain Now'
item.description: Many Calgary Flames fans aren't happy to see MacKenzie Weegar get traded to the Utah Mammoth, but some have put their faith in GM Craig Conroy's long-term vision for the team.

item.title: Why The Blackhawks Received A First-Rounder From The Oilers In Jason Dickinson Trade
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers acquired Jason Dickinson and Colton Dach from the Chicago Blackhawks in exchange for a top-12 protected first-round pick and Andrew Mangiapane.
